title: Task sync stage 1: verify and run the ordinary migration for the model-A cutover, with no conversion code
outcome: The model-A release reaches every live store through the existing migration export/import, with no conversion code
acceptance: Before cutover, a census with the model-A build shows every live store holds no task-sync import, planning, binding or exchange record, so model A's new heads and holds start empty; nothing is seeded, fabricated or lazily derived. If any store holds some, stop and report to Greg.

The ordinary migration, export with the current build and import with the model-A build, of a COPY of each live store succeeds with unchanged per-table row counts, ids, links and bytes; the new model-A tables start empty and doctor plus readiness are healthy; a store holding an origin-created task without a head refuses before publish. The results and the cutover plan (store and consumer census, export and backups, fresh destination validation, swap, rollback and the coordinated restart) go to Greg before landing.

Tests use isolated stores only, inside the existing migration test owners: one round trip of a pre-model-A-shaped store into the model-A schema stays healthy with empty new tables, and an origin-created task without a head refuses. No conversion module, format selector, report field, build identity, legacy refusal or conversion-only fixture is added.
disposal_reason: Superseded and not recoverable as written (Engram::Fable, coordinator disposition, 2026-11-16 04:28Z). Coder 11323 searched, within bounds, for the pre-cutover model-A census, the per-store copy migrations and Greg's pre-landing plan, and could not recover them; Opus and the Merger couldn't find them either (gap note a5fcc713 on this item). The model-A rows landed in 5e8f28dd on 2 Nov, and every live store has since been through later agreed cutovers (the AACB cutover of 12-13 Nov, with Greg's „tak jest OK”, and later installs), and runs the current schema with readiness ready. So the one-time migration this item planned is past and can't be redone meaningfully now. Closed under rules-greg-close-senseless-tasks-2026-11-08.
